❗How to play Guess the Person 
Take turns asking questions. "Is it a man?" "Do they have brown hair?" You only press buttons. No typing.
Your opponent answers Yes or No. Then you look at THEIR board and flip down every face that cannot be it.
When one face is left on their board, guess it. The match does not end there. Your opponent gets time to make their guess too. Then both guesses are shown at the same time. You can BOTH be right.

👑 You get crowns when you win. Use crowns to buy win emotes - a dance your character does on the win screen, so the other player sees it.
🤖 Nobody to play with? Press Play Alone. A bot sits in the other seat and plays a real match.
⭐ How to play

1. Sit on a chair in the lobby
2. Pick your secret face
3. Ask, answer, flip
4. Guess their face before they guess yours

badges.description: It opened its mouth in the dark and you made it home anyway. Next time it opens wide, let the dark have you.
badges.name: First Shift

badges.description: A grinning face scratched into the wall. A red face on your map. It’s slower than you. Remember that.
badges.name: The Head

badges.description: It stares. You can’t move while it stares. Something about paper makes it look away.
badges.name: The Works

badges.description: They only want the light. You heard the wings and you gave them the dark.
badges.name: Into the Vents

badges.description: When the pipes shook, you found the holes in the walls. Somebody dug them for a reason.
badges.name: Cold Mains

badges.description: The night janitor is blind. He hears everything. You learned to be still when the bucket squeaks.
badges.name: Blackout

badges.description: The floor breathed under you and you kept moving. The ones who sat still are still down there.
badges.name: Soft Ground

badges.description: He only takes people in the dark. The moths want the dark. You had to choose, every time.
badges.name: The Lantern Man

badges.description: Three caps a junction. You never shorted him. Never crawled into him. Not even backwards.
badges.name: Toll Roads

badges.description: Management would like a word about your performance. You never stopped moving. Custom Night is yours.
badges.name: Head Office

badges.description: The vents are clean. Too clean. It crawls on its hands and it smiles the whole way. Out of sight is out of mind.
badges.name: Clean Air

badges.description: It cleans the same route every night. Every night. Learn it. Don’t be on it.
badges.name: Scheduled Maintenance

badges.description: When the rats run, run with them. The yellow air is slower than you. Don’t wait to find out how slow.
badges.name: Pest Control

badges.description: She smiles when she hands it to you. Take it. Be where it says. And if you can’t... get home.
badges.name: You’ve Been Served

badges.description: It got bigger. It got faster. It’s still smiling. Nothing in the vents has ever been this hungry.
badges.name: Final Inspection

badges.description: She just wants a hug. Most people crawl away. Don’t.
badges.name: Grandma’s Favorite

badges.description: Sixty seconds. Somebody’s frozen in the dark and banging on the glass. Go get them.
badges.name: Ice Breaker

badges.description: He can’t stand the light. Strike one in his face and watch him run.
badges.name: Flash Bang

badges.description: Three caps. Three times. Tom says never short him.
badges.name: Exact Change

badges.description: Everything down here has a rule. You learned ten of them the hard way.
badges.name: Seen Them All

badges.description: You said no. She stopped smiling. The safe room is the only place she can’t follow.
badges.name: Contempt of Court

badges.description:
Head Office. The whole crew walked out. Nobody has ever done that.

Beat Ch1 Night 10 with nobody in the crew dying
badges.name: Untouched

badges.description:
No crew. No radio voices but his. Just you and Head Office.

Beat Ch1 Night 10 solo
badges.name: Lone Shift

badges.description: Ten nights. Hard mode. Every single one. PIPE CO. thanks you for your service.
badges.name: Overtime

badges.description: Clear Chapter 1 nights 1 → 10 in order without dying once, on any difficulty.
badges.name: PIPES Hardcore

badges.description: Clear night 10 without using a single item.
badges.name: Bare Hands

badges.description: Clear night 6, 7 or 8 crawling backward more than forward (at least 10 backward crawls).
badges.name: Reverse Gear

badges.description: Clear night 9 or 10 without going back into the safe room after you’ve left it.
badges.name: No Safe Place

badges.description: Clear night 10 on HARD without your heat ever dropping below half (I picked 50%; the suggestion said 50–75%).
badges.name: A Cup of Coffee

badges.description: Clear Chapter 2, Night 6. Something waits at the end of the long ducts, breathing. When it screams, get off the line. You can’t outrun it.
badges.name: Fresh Cuts

badges.description: Clear Chapter 2, Night 7. They never clocked out. If something leans out of a hiding hole and stares at you, that hole’s taken.
badges.name: Old Staff

badges.description: Clear Chapter 2, Night 8. The new guy keeps undoing your work, and the ducts are wired. Wait for the zap, then go.
badges.name: Probation

badges.description: Clear Chapter 2, Night 9. It came down with the rain. Never stop under it, and don’t splash.
badges.name: Water Damage

badges.description: Clear Chapter 2, Night 10. Burn every growth. Stay cold. She’s dead, and the vents are finally quiet.
badges.name: Mother

badges.description: Grab every bottle cap on the map in one night. Nights 8-10.
badges.name: The Collector

badges.description: Beat a Custom Night with every monster at 20 on HARD. Good luck.
badges.name: Ultimate Custom Night

badges.description: With one smoke bomb, crawl right past 3 monsters before it wears off.
badges.name: Must’ve Been the Wind

badges.description: Finish every task of a night using only wrenches.
badges.name: Toolbox

badges.description: While the Process Server is hunting you, finish a task without a wrench and live.
badges.name: Fearless

badges.description: Have Randal, the Foreman and the Janitor all chasing you at the same time.
badges.name: Irritate Them All

badges.description: Beat Chapter 1 Night 6, 7 or 8 without ever opening your map.
badges.name: Sixth Sense

badges.description: Survive Rampage without hiding or using an item.
badges.name: High Risk, No Reward

badges.description: In one night: scare the Janitor with a wrench, lure the Moths with a glow stick, and scare Randal with a flare.
badges.name: Versatile

badges.description: Beat a night with your heat lamp on for less than 2 seconds total.
badges.name: I Need No Light

badges.description: Get charged by the Flesh 3 times in one night and never get hit.
badges.name: Not On The Menu

badges.description: Get peeked at by a Faceling 10 times in one night and live.
badges.name: Face to Face

badges.description: Shoo the Temp off 3 times in one night with your heat lamp.
badges.name: HR Complaint

badges.description: Lead a monster that’s chasing you into a zap gate as it fires.
badges.name: Shock Therapy

badges.description: Beat Chapter 2 Night 9 without splashing a single puddle.
badges.name: Dry Run

badges.description: Burn 3 of the growths yourself in one night. (Ch.2 Night 10)
badges.name: That's Fire Bro

badges.description: Clear Chapter 1 Nights 1-10 AND Chapter 2 Nights 1-10, in order, without dying once. PIPE CO. thanks you for your service.
badges.name: No Sick Days

Late October. Hollow Pine is on lockdown, and you're trapped in a cabin deep in the woods. Something tall has been watching from the treeline all night. Now it wants inside.

10768943703.creator: RWAF Studios
10768943703.description:
Rally with a Friend! Early access is here!

Team up with a friend and take on narrow roads, blind corners and jumps. One player drives while the copilot calls turns using a handheld map. Hold onto it, or drop it into the cabin.

Explore Finland, Sweden, Utah and Japan, with two stages per country and day or night driving (way more to come 👀). Face fog, rain, snow, dirty windshields and headlights that can cut out. (also a lot more features are planned)

Meet in the pits (hub), form a party and enter your own private stage. Optional passes unlock Japan Touge and more cars, including the Ponda, WRC car and four-seat XRW for up to four players.

Finish clean stages to earn REP, set personal bests and climb the leaderboards. Hard crashes can cause blackouts and cost REP. Solo driving is available with a dashboard map, but solo times are not ranked.

Are you here to mess around with friends or chase the fastest time?

Original Credits to Left! Left! LEFT! on Steam. GO PLAY IT!
10768943703.name: [RACING UPDATE] Rally With a Friend

10768944292.creator: Project Mirvy
10768944292.description:
🦖 Welcome to Prehistoric Farm 🦖

Dig up the past and bring it back to life! Sail across wild islands, unearth ancient fossils, and turn them into eggs at Dr. Ivy's DNA Lab. Hatch your very own dinosaurs, raise them from tiny Newborns into huge Elders, and ride them across your ranch!

[How To Play]
▪ Grab your shovel and hold down on a dig site. Let go when the meter is in the green for a better find!
▪ Collect a full set of fossils and bring them to Dr. Ivy to grow an egg
▪ Warm your egg in the incubator and watch it hatch
▪ Keep your dino's belly over half full so it keeps growing
▪ Once it's grown, hop on and ride your partner dino around the islands!

[Explore]
▪ Buy bigger boats and sail to new fossil islands
▪ Fish the open sea and dive for rare catches
▪ Sneak into the Sunken Grotto to steal sea reptile eggs
▪ Team up with other players to take down the giant Mosasaurus with spears!

Works on PC, mobile and console.
10768944292.name: Prehistoric Farm [NEW WORLD 🎃]

Save the city or watch it fall.

1087859240.description:
>> This game is incredibly difficult with little to no hand holding. Enter at your own risk. << 

Nominee for "Sleeper Hit" in the 7th Annual Bloxy Awards. 

Rogue Lineage is a fantasy game with roguelike elements. The game revolves around a permadeath mechanic, where each of your characters will have but a few lives before they die forever. You'll pass down some pieces of yourself to your heir, who'll become your next character. Players will progress by learning new abilities and trying to best their previous characters. Forge houses with your friends to take control of cities, or stick it out alone. Tackle injuries, diseases, and trauma as you struggle to survive in this testament to pain. 

Developed by: Ragoozer, Arch_Mage, Grimmkind, Melon_Sensei, aptorian, Rookie_Ethnic, Sherosama Contributions from: Nilvaat (Weapon Modelling), Blotnik (Clothing), x_o (Music), superstephon (Weapon Modelling)

Race through the streets on a ‘Boneshaker’ velocipede, fly through the air on a steampunk flying machine or paddle down the river and view the city from the safety of your very own rowing boat.

There are more than 100 badges to be won from around this beautiful Victorian city.  Can you clear the rats from the courtyard and pick up pure from the streets, to earn some money for food?

Beware of rogues, ghosts, deadly traps and other dangers!

This game is based on an authentic reconstruction of 1867 Luxembourg. Historical documents and photographs have been used throughout, to create an authentic impression of what the city would have looked like during the mid-nineteenth century.

Embark on an epic journey through the War Seas, taking part in the conflicts of kingdoms and organizations striving for power. Many will die, but only the strong survive in this harsh, magic-polluted world.

1184233856.description:

controls 
LMB - shoot (repair in build mode) 
RMB - aim (damage in build mode) 
E - melee 
G (5-6) - grenade 
R - reload (hold to rotate in build mode) 
Q - cycle sights 
V - cycle firing mode 
T - toggle/cycle all attachment modes 
F - interact 
`/~ - free mouse/manual attachment mode toggle (open buildable menu in build mode) 
B - enter build mode 
shift - sprint 

Paid access price will lower as development milestones are reached. Your cash will be reset & levels/weapons records will be reduced by 80% once the game fully releases.

Welcome to Edgeworks! a VR exclusive game about physics puzzles, freerunning, parkour and climbing!

If you have Criticism/critique, or issues with the game PLEASE get in touch.

Known headsets compatibility issues:
Oculus: None. this game was developed and designed around Oculus Headsets.

Vive, WMR, Valve Index: Jumping can be done by clicking the right thumbstick. (or middle of the trackpad)
mag dropping can only be done by tapping the current mag with a fresh one.

these issues are caused by the roblox engine, and are not likely to be fixed until roblox themselves fix it. (which is not likely)

Creative Attributes: 
https://devforum.roblox.com/t/edgeworks-creative-attributes/957041

I feel like I shouldn't have to say this, but this game REQUIRES a VR headset.

Exploiting of any sorts is NOT allowed in this game, and you will be punished for it.

How to play:
The board is divided into tiles, with mines randomly distributed.
To win, you need to step on all the safe tiles, without stepping on a mine.
The number on a tile shows the number of mines around it in a 3x3 area.
Using this information, you can determine tiles that are safe, and tiles that contain mines.
Tiles suspected of being mines can be marked with a flag using the left mouse button.

🦈 Welcome to Fisch 🦈

Dive into Fisch, the ultimate fishing adventure where exploration and progression are yours to control. Cast your line to catch rare and unique fish, each with 400,000+ possible variations. Explore a growing world with your trusty rod, and maybe even reel in some new friends along the way!

[How To Fish]
• Hold down to cast your bobber
• Await a bite. You can "shake" your rod to attract fish faster
• When you have a bite, hold down or click to pull the white bar. Follow the blue line to the best of your ability; it's okay to mess up a few times!
• When the progress bar on the bottom is full, you'll reel in your catch!
